units: <cite ref="Berakhot 56a:19">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>חזאי דנפל ת׳ בתרתין וכ׳</he> I saw in my dream that decay had seized two of my fingers.
<cite ref="Berakhot 56a:19">Ib.</cite> <he>נפל ת׳ בכולהו שיראי</he> decay (through moths, v. <cite ref="V00536"><he>תְּכַךְ</he> II</cite>) has seized all the silk garments (of the royal wardrobe).

<cite ref="Chullin 64b:3">Ḥull. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>דשדא ת׳ בכולה</he> for it (the drop of blood on the yolk of an egg) spreads decay over the whole of it.—Pl. <he>תִּכלי</he>, <cite ref="V00014"><he>תִּי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:8">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>שתין ת׳ וכ׳</he> sixty decays (pains) &c., v. <cite ref="K00656"><he>כַּכָּא</he></cite>.
